scope: All packaged files under src/exojax, including coefficient and test data. This initial inventory maps the main scientific families and selected variants; it is not an exhaustive review of every branch, callback or external dataset. Only inspected API/model-boundary files are classified. Other files remain visible as unreviewed, and uncontracted families retain explicit gaps. The six linked contracts cover scoped shared definitions, not complete provider equivalence or physical accuracy. Research examples, observation-specific priors/likelihoods and external downloads are outside the scan roots. File hashes identify an inspection snapshot, not an execution or scientific judgment.
